name: ef_select_draw
description: The select-group draw. A fresh manager seeds its cRZRandomSuper with 0x1105 at construction and never reseeds it; the first tempered word is 0xAAE64AC3, so r = RandomUint32Uniform(0x10000) = 43750. volcano_control's nine meta creators carry weights 7281 x 8 and 7287, whose running sums 7281, 14562, ... first reach >= 43750 at the 7th member -- volcanocreator4a, brush record 8. The next five draws give r = 24188, 47502, 45072, 37594 and 53135, picking members 4, 7, 7, 6 and 8 (1-based).

steps.note: 17 test 3: the first draw on a fresh manager
